record.name: Entertainer
record.description: You are a performer, artist, or public figure who has learned to captivate audiences and navigate the world of entertainment. Whether you're a musician, actor, dancer, or other type of performer, your charisma and artistic talents make you a natural leader and communicator. You understand how to read crowds and use your charm to get what you want.

feature.name: By Popular Demand
feature.description: You can always find a place to perform, usually in an inn or tavern but possibly with a circus, at a theater, or even in a noble's court. At such a place, you receive free lodging and food of a modest or comfortable standard (depending on the quality of the establishment), as long as you perform each night. In addition, your performance makes you something of a local figure. When strangers recognize you in a town where you have performed, they typically take a liking to you.

effects.notes: Free lodging and food at performance venues
Recognition and positive reputation in places where you've performed

traits: I know a story relevant to almost every situation.
I am incredibly slow to trust.
I am always calm, no matter what the situation.
I use multisyllabic words that others don't understand.
I have a strong sense of fair play.
I am haunted by memories of war.
I don't talk about the thing that torments me.
I idolize a particular hero of my faction and refer to them constantly.
ideals: Beauty. When I perform, I make the world better than it was.
Independence. I am a free spirit—no one tells me what to do.
Power. I will do whatever it takes to become powerful.
Peace. I will not be the one to draw my weapon first.
Greed. I will do whatever it takes to become wealthy.
bonds: I owe a debt to the person who trained me.
I'm on the run from a crime lord I crossed.
I'm trying to pay off an old debt I owe to a benefactor.
My ill-gotten gains go to support my family.
I have a family to provide for.
I am searching for my former master.
flaws: I am overly critical of others' flaws.
I am haunted by visions of the future.
My pride sometimes gets the better of me.
I can't resist a pretty face.
When I see something valuable, I can't think about anything but how to steal it.
When faced with a choice between my friends and my mission, I'll choose my mission.
